## Minimum Viable Understanding (MVU)

After hyperfixation, the ADHD trough phase impairs executive function more than the ADHD baseline. Three causes combine, and they show up as six manifestations. The resulting undone tasks feed back into the cause through stress. Each proposition below is its own note, and this note only arranges them.

---

## 1. Causes

Executive function is already weak in ADHD ([[Executive Function]]). Three trough-specific causes deepen that weakness.

![[Prefrontal Cortex Catecholamine Insufficiency Impairs Executive Control in ADHD#^claim]]

![[Dopamine Depletion in the ADHD Trough Phase Weakens Prefrontal Executive Function Below Its Usual Baseline#^claim]]

![[Hyperfixation Depletes the Cognitive Resources That Executive Control Depends On#^claim]]

![[Prefrontal Cortex Activation Falls Further During the ADHD Trough Phase#^claim]]

---

## 2. Manifestations

The causes above show up in six executive functions.

![[The ADHD Trough Phase Makes Starting Even Basic Necessary Tasks Impossible#^claim]]

![[The ADHD Trough Phase Breaks Down Planning and Makes Minor Decisions Overwhelming#^claim]]

![[Time Awareness Is Poor During the ADHD Trough Phase#^claim]]

![[Emotional Regulation Worsens During the ADHD Trough Phase#^claim]]

![[Working Memory Fails During the ADHD Trough Phase#^claim]]

---

## 3. Compounding Effect

The manifestations leave tasks undone, and that closes a loop back to the causes.

![[Undone Tasks From the ADHD Trough Phase Raise Stress That Further Impairs Executive Function#^claim]]

---

t=open(p).read()
head,body=t.split("\n## Systems are Blind",1)
body="## Systems are Blind"+body
i=body.index("### Scope & Conditions")
opening=body[:i]
new=opening+"""### Scope & Conditions

Applies to bounded, self-maintaining systems whose sensors and criteria of relevance are defined internally. External events register only as disruptions to internal variables.

### Evidence

Analogical support from the library, not direct statements of the claim.

> "we are shielded from the lower levels, the neural tangle. Our thoughts seem to run about in their own space"
> (Hofstadter 1979, "CHAPTER XX: Strange Loops, Or Tangled Hierarchies", p. 691) · [open in Calibre](calibre://view-book/GCcalibreBooks/1132/PDF)

> "once you hit your head against the ceiling like this, where you are prevented from jumping out of the system to a yet higher authority"
> (Hofstadter 1979, "CHAPTER XX: Strange Loops, Or Tangled Hierarchies", p. 691) · [open in Calibre](calibre://view-book/GCcalibreBooks/1132/PDF)

> "Systems blindness is the main thing we struggle with in our work"
> (Daniel 2013, ch. 13, PDF p. 115, quoting John Sterman) · [open in Calibre](calibre://view-book/GCcalibreBooks/697/EPUB?open_at=toc:13%20System%20Blindness)

### Implications

- Bounded systems must build self-referential rules because they cannot import external context.
- Actors inside a subsystem optimise for local coherence, even when that harms the wider system.
- Testing a system's assumptions needs a view from outside its boundary.

### Related

- [[Autopoiesis The Self-Referential System]]—foundation: a self-producing system's boundary separates inside from outside.
[depends_on:: [[Autopoiesis The Self-Referential System]], strength=5, confidence=high]
- [[Trinity of Systems]]—foundation: elements, interconnections and purpose bound what a system registers.
[depends_on:: [[Trinity of Systems]], strength=4, confidence=high]
- [[SoT - Systems Thinking]]—parent synthesis.
[extends:: [[SoT - Systems Thinking]], confidence=high]
- [[Systems Generate Internal Logic in Isolation]]—consequence: blindness forces self-referential rules.
[supports:: [[Systems Generate Internal Logic in Isolation]], strength=5, confidence=high]
- [[Local Rationality Within a Subsystem Often Produces Irrational Outcomes for the Whole System]]—consequence: no whole-system view means locally rational failure.
[supports:: [[Local Rationality Within a Subsystem Often Produces Irrational Outcomes for the Whole System]], strength=4, confidence=high]
- [[MOC - The Logic of Self-Contained Systems]]—parent map, stage 1.

### Tensions

- [[Open Knowledge Systems Prevail Over Closed Systems]]—tension, not contradiction: open systems deliberately import external refutation.

### Further Reading

- Hofstadter, Douglas R. 1979. *Gödel, Escher, Bach: An Eternal Golden Braid*. Basic Books. [Open in Calibre](calibre://view-book/GCcalibreBooks/1132/PDF)—_corroborates by analogy._
